ModMetaData.name: Social Drug Policy
ModMetaData.author: Gapho
ModMetaData.description:
Adds two buttons to the drug policy window.
"Allow all social drugs" allows every social drug for recreation in the policy you are editing.
"Limit social drug tolerance" sets the "only if tolerance below" limit of every social drug to the minimum tolerance for addiction of that drug. So a colonist stops taking a social drug before a new addiction is possible.
The second button needs the mod "Only If 'Tolerance' Below in Drug Policy". Without it, that button is hidden.
